claim: Jesus was crucified under Pontius Pilate.

bible.note: Jesus is handed to Pilate, who orders the crucifixion.
A longer account of the trial before Pilate.
Pilate is named in an early creed-like statement.

outside.note: A Roman historian, no friend of Christians, says Christ was executed under Tiberius by the procurator Pontius Pilate.
Says Pilate condemned Jesus to the cross. The passage was likely expanded by later Christian copyists, but most scholars think a core statement is original.
An inscription found in 1961 confirming Pilate was a real Roman governor of Judea. It does not mention Jesus.

counter: Tacitus may be passing on what Christians told him rather than independent records. Josephus has a known editing problem. The strength comes from several unrelated sources agreeing, including hostile ones.
